title: Require Service Contract Property Descriptions
forbids: a directly authored TypeBox object property in a service module contract without a nonblank static description
why: Contract properties are the public vocabulary exposed to clients and generated protocol documentation. Their meaning must be declared where the contract authors the property instead of being inferred from its name.
remediate: Use the imported canonical Type binding directly, without import or local aliases. Add a truthful nonblank single- or double-quoted description under the unquoted description key, delegate the property to a named *Schema authority, or spread a named *Schema.properties authority.
message: Directly authored service contract properties must declare their semantic meaning.
